method: The current body-owned Holy Metropolis pages control exact current identities. It reports 285 chapels and 14 cemetery churches only as aggregates, so no unnamed residual is invented. A current Blogspot result describes itself as a friends page for Prophet Elijah Monastery at Erythres. The competent exact body page does not link it, and the blog does not establish ownership by the monastery. It is not classified as a direct body website.

A commercial locality directory prints an additional landline, email, and more specific street description for Panagia Hodegetria Monastery. Only the current phone and address printed by the competent body-owned detail page are published. The third-party-only additions remain held.

Search results for gorgoepikoos.gr concern a different Panagia Gorgoepikoos monastery near Edessa. The domain is not a direct site for the Mandra monastery and is excluded from that row.

The current Megara roster and the Athens chapel roster both identify Saint Paraskevi on Aiolou Street as the Athens metochion of Osios Meletios Monastery. It is one dependency and is published once in this canonical roster, not as separate chapel and metochion bodies.

source_reconciliations.result: The body-owned parish page exposes 32 exact current cards in four archieratical groups of 6, 9, 6, and 11. The Church of Greece administrative record independently reports 32 parish churches and names the same exact roster.

The current body-owned chapel page and Church of Greece record agree on one episcopal-residence chapel, four metropolitan chapels, one pilgrimage church, and one hospital church. The much larger unnamed chapel and cemetery aggregates are held rather than inferred.

The current body-owned roster names six male and ten female monasteries, exactly matching the Church of Greece aggregate of 16 monastic churches. Panagia Hodegetria is published because its current exact post now classifies it among the six male monasteries, superseding the older profile wording that called it under establishment.

The current body-owned page names seven exact metochia. All seven appear in the Church of Greece administrative record, which also names one additional Saint John Kalyvites dependency absent from the current roster. The seven current identities are published and the profile-only eighth is held.

Every valid phone on the 32 current parish detail pages and 15 of the 16 current monastery detail pages is retained, including mobile and clergy-linked public routes. Saint Catherine Monastery has a dash-only phone field and therefore carries no contact audit metadata. The current exact pages expose no body email, fax, or verified direct body website.

official_parent_audit.result: The Church of Greece profile and body-owned site establish the current canonical Holy Metropolis of Megara and Salamis.

The three current body-owned roster pages and their exact detail posts control current identity and contact facts. The linked Church of Greece administrative record corroborates counts and identities without creating unnamed aggregate rows.

exclusions.reason: The Metropolis central switchboard, fax, general email, and office address repeated in the site footer and Church profile are not copied to subordinate bodies.
Clergy and monastic personal names and role labels are omitted. A public phone remains only when the exact body page presents it as the contact route for that body.
Dissolved monasteries, unnamed chapel and cemetery aggregates, historical-only churches, and the older profile-only metochion are not published as current bodies.

Map-only, search-only, friends-page, social-network, commercial-directory, tourism, and municipal-history leads do not create rows or body-owned-site claims without current competent canonical confirmation.
